title: MSFS 2020 isn't dead! New 2026 missions & ultra-realism challenges
description:
Are you looking for fresh ways to explore the world in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? Today, we’re diving into four brand-new featured activities that just hit the Marketplace.

From heavy-duty IFR journeys to technical landing challenges in the frozen north, there is plenty of content to keep your hangar busy this week. We’ll look at the new "Spring 2026" packs for Spirit and Wizz Air, go "all sides" in Australia, and test our skills against Canada's most notorious weather.

In this video, we cover:

- Spirit & Wizz Spring 2026: 12-leg IFR journeys with "Extreme Realism" event monitoring (100+ events!).  
- The Livery Catch: Important details on the differences between MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024 versions.
- Advanced Challenges Canada: 20 technical missions ranging from Toronto Pearson to remote BC bush strips.  
- Australia All Sides (Part 1): A new sightseeing tour by Koshi exploring the latest World Update landmarks.

Aircraft Featured: 
- Airbus A320neo
- Cessna Grand Caravan,
- various bush planes.

Which of these missions are you tackling first? Let me know in the comments!
